```artifact
Feature: Alarms Configuration
  As a user
  I want to configure alarms for HIGH RR, LOW RR, and apnea
  So that I can set thresholds for each alarm type

  Scenario: Configure HIGH RR alarm threshold
    Given the HIGH RR alarm threshold control is visible
    When I set the HIGH RR alarm threshold to 10
    Then the HIGH RR alarm threshold is set to 10

  Scenario: Configure LOW RR alarm threshold
    Given the LOW RR alarm threshold control is visible
    When I set the LOW RR alarm threshold to 15
    Then the LOW RR alarm threshold is set to 15

  Scenario: Configure apnea alarm threshold
    Given the apnea alarm threshold control is visible
    When I set the apnea alarm threshold to 5 seconds
    Then the apnea alarm threshold is set to 5 seconds

  Scenario: HIGH RR alarm threshold out of range
    Given the HIGH RR alarm threshold control is visible
    When I set the HIGH RR alarm threshold to 4
    Then an error message is displayed indicating the threshold is out of range

  Scenario: LOW RR alarm threshold out of range
    Given the LOW RR alarm threshold control is visible
    When I set the LOW RR alarm threshold to 31
    Then an error message is displayed indicating the threshold is out of range

  Scenario: Apnea alarm threshold out of range
    Given the apnea alarm threshold control is visible
    When I set the apnea alarm threshold to 0 seconds
    Then an error message is displayed indicating the threshold is out of range

  Scenario Outline: HIGH RR alarm threshold increments
    Given the HIGH RR alarm threshold control is visible
    When I set the HIGH RR alarm threshold to <threshold>
    Then the HIGH RR alarm threshold is set to <threshold>

    Examples:
      | threshold |
      | 5         |
      | 10        |
      | 15        |
      | 20        |
      | 25        |
      | 30        |

  Scenario Outline: LOW RR alarm threshold increments
    Given the LOW RR alarm threshold control is visible
    When I set the LOW RR alarm threshold to <threshold>
    Then the LOW RR alarm threshold is set to <threshold>

    Examples:
      | threshold |
      | 5         |
      | 10        |
      | 15        |
      | 20        |
      | 25        |
      | 30        |

  Scenario Outline: Apnea alarm threshold increments
    Given the apnea alarm threshold control is visible
    When I set the apnea alarm threshold to <threshold> seconds
    Then the apnea alarm threshold is set to <threshold> seconds

    Examples:
      | threshold |
      | 1         |
      | 5         |
      | 10        |
      | 15        |
      | 20        |
      | 30        |

  Scenario: Relief valve open alarm
    Given the relief valve open alarm is enabled
    When the relief valve opens unexpectedly
    Then an alarm is triggered indicating the relief valve has opened
```
